import ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA
open ArithmeticCode254 ValidatorProvability254 ValidatorQuantifierCore254
open ValidatorNativeGic254 ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic

#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.cProv_imp_mono
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.cProv_conj_mono
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.internalGic_matrix_imp
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.internalGic_matrix_equivalent
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.internalGic_pad_equivalent
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.cProv_unpaddedGic_bounded
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.cProv_unpaddedGic
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.cProv_closed_unpaddedGic

variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
example (p p' q q' : V) (hp : CProv (wim p' p)) (hq : CProv (wim q q')) :
    CProv (wim (wim p q) (wim p' q')) := cProv_imp_mono hp hq
example (p p' q q' : V) (hp : CProv (wim p p')) (hq : CProv (wim q q')) :
    CProv (wim (conj p q) (conj p' q')) := cProv_conj_mono hp hq
example (a b c p q : V) (hpq : CProv (wim p q)) (hqp : CProv (wim q p)) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b c p) (internalGic a b c q)) :=
  internalGic_matrix_imp a b c hpq hqp
example (a b c p q : V) (hpq : CProv (wim p q)) (hqp : CProv (wim q p)) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b c p) (internalGic a b c q)) ∧
      CProv (wim (internalGic a b c q) (internalGic a b c p)) :=
  internalGic_matrix_equivalent a b c hpq hqp
example (a b p : V) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b (pad p) p) (internalGic a b (pad p) (pad p))) :=
  (internalGic_pad_equivalent a b p).1
example (a b p : V) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b (pad p) (pad p)) (internalGic a b (pad p) p)) :=
  (internalGic_pad_equivalent a b p).2
example (a b p : V) (ha : a ≤ 3) (hb : b ≤ 3) :
    CProv (internalGic a b (pad p) p) := cProv_unpaddedGic_bounded a b p ha hb
example (p : V) : CProv (internalGic 1 3 (pad p) p) := cProv_unpaddedGic p
example (p : V) : CProv (wal 3 (internalGic 1 3 (pad p) p)) :=
  cProv_closed_unpaddedGic p
example : CProv (wal (3 : V) (internalGic 1 3 (pad 0) 0)) :=
  cProv_closed_unpaddedGic 0
example (a p q : V) (hpq : CProv (wim p q)) (hqp : CProv (wim q p)) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a a a p) (internalGic a a a q)) :=
  internalGic_matrix_imp a a a hpq hqp
text_by_sha256.e8f4c30a9d7a72f2bc71ccf910ef1c406768cc20:
import ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGic254

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Finite matrix congruence for the literal validator GIC circuit. All codes and
labels are arbitrary values of an internal arithmetic model. The circuit's
three labels stay fixed throughout; no freshness or renaming premise is used.
Padding is removed from the matrix while its witness label remains `pad p`.
This does not identify a configurable Foundation encoding or prove alpha
transport, arbitrary universal closure, or an internal consistency endpoint.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open _root_.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open ArithmeticCode254
open ValidatorProvability254 ValidatorQuantifierCore254 ValidatorNativeGic254
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic

variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private abbrev D (G : List V) (p : V) := Kalmar.Der wim CProv G p
private lemma h0 {G : List V} {a : V} : D (a :: G) a := .cons_head
private lemma h1 {G : List V} {a b : V} : D (b :: a :: G) a :=
  .hyp (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
private lemma ofDer {p : V} (d : D [] p) : CProv p :=
  d.sound cProv_classical (fun _ hm => absurd hm List.not_mem_nil)
private lemma ded2 {a b p : V} (d : D [b, a] p) : CProv (wim a (wim b p)) :=
  ofDer (Kalmar.deduction cProv_classical (Kalmar.deduction cProv_classical d))

/-- Implication is contravariant in its antecedent and covariant in its consequent. -/
lemma cProv_imp_mono {p p' q q' : V}
    (hp : CProv (wim p' p)) (hq : CProv (wim q q')) :
    CProv (wim (wim p q) (wim p' q')) :=
  ded2 (.mp (.ax hq) (.mp h1 (.mp (.ax hp) h0)))

lemma cProv_conj_mono {p p' q q' : V}
    (hp : CProv (wim p p')) (hq : CProv (wim q q')) :
    CProv (wim (conj p q) (conj p' q')) :=
  contrapose_of (cProv_imp_mono hp (contrapose_of hq))

/-- Both matrix directions are needed because the matrix occurs in both polarities. -/
lemma internalGic_matrix_imp (a b c : V) {p q : V}
    (hpq : CProv (wim p q)) (hqp : CProv (wim q p)) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b c p) (internalGic a b c q)) := by
  have hpair : CProv (wim (conj p (wel b c)) (conj q (wel b c))) :=
    cProv_conj_mono hpq (Kalmar.self_imp cProv_classical (wel b c))
  have hmatrix : CProv
      (wim (wim p (ex b (conj p (wel b c))))
        (wim q (ex b (conj q (wel b c))))) :=
    cProv_imp_mono hqp (ex_mono b hpair)
  have hleft : CProv
      (wim (wal a (wim (wel a b) (wal b (wim p (ex b (conj p (wel b c)))))))
        (wal a (wim (wel a b) (wal b (wim q (ex b (conj q (wel b c)))))))) :=
    all_mono a (cProv_imp_mono (Kalmar.self_imp cProv_classical (wel a b))
      (all_mono b hmatrix))
  have hright : CProv
      (wim (wal b (wim (wel b c) (ex a p)))
        (wal b (wim (wel b c) (ex a q)))) :=
    all_mono b (cProv_imp_mono (Kalmar.self_imp cProv_classical (wel b c))
      (ex_mono a hpq))
  exact ex_mono c (cProv_conj_mono hleft hright)

lemma internalGic_matrix_equivalent (a b c : V) {p q : V}
    (hpq : CProv (wim p q)) (hqp : CProv (wim q p)) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b c p) (internalGic a b c q)) ∧
      CProv (wim (internalGic a b c q) (internalGic a b c p)) :=
  ⟨internalGic_matrix_imp a b c hpq hqp, internalGic_matrix_imp a b c hqp hpq⟩

/-- The existential witness label is the same `pad p` on both sides. -/
lemma internalGic_pad_equivalent (a b p : V) :
    CProv (wim (internalGic a b (pad p) p) (internalGic a b (pad p) (pad p))) ∧
      CProv (wim (internalGic a b (pad p) (pad p)) (internalGic a b (pad p) p)) :=
  internalGic_matrix_equivalent a b (pad p) (pad_equivalent p).1 (pad_equivalent p).2

lemma cProv_unpaddedGic_bounded (a b p : V) (ha : a ≤ 3) (hb : b ≤ 3) :
    CProv (internalGic a b (pad p) p) :=
  cProv_mp (internalGic_pad_equivalent a b p).2 (cProv_paddedGic_bounded a b p ha hb)

theorem cProv_unpaddedGic (p : V) : CProv (internalGic 1 3 (pad p) p) :=
  cProv_mp (internalGic_pad_equivalent 1 3 p).2 (cProv_paddedGic p)

/-- Generalize the domain label only, retaining the literal circuit and witness label. -/
theorem cProv_closed_unpaddedGic (p : V) :
    CProv (wal 3 (internalGic 1 3 (pad p) p)) :=
  cProv_gen 3 (cProv_unpaddedGic p)

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254

The source proves fixed-label congruence for the literal internal GIC circuit in an arbitrary arithmetic model of IΣ₁. If the literal validator proves both implications between matrix values p and q, it proves both implications between internalGic a b c p and internalGic a b c q. All three labels remain unchanged. The matrix appears positively and negatively, so the forward circuit implication uses both matrix implications.

The proof is finite. Its small Kalmar derivation follows the already checked private deduction helpers in ValidatorQuantifierCore254. Implication transport reverses the antecedent direction; conjunction transport follows by contraposition. Existing all_mono and ex_mono then transport these implications through the literal circuit. There is no recursion on syntax, no freshness premise for congruence, and no increase in proof limits.

The padding corollary specializes this transport to pad_equivalent. It removes pad from the matrix while retaining c = pad p on both sides. Actual introduction still uses the existing numeric gates for labels at most 3; the final two corollaries specialize to labels 1 and 3 and generalize the domain label 3. They do not replace the collection label with p, identify a Foundation encoding, rename binders, or establish arbitrary universal closure or consistency transport. The audit explicitly includes p = 0 and coincident-label congruence.

Source and audit are frozen at 89 and 45 lines, with 8 fully qualified probes and 11 typed callers. The direct import is only ZFCinPA.ValidatorNativeGic254. The selected parent is the existing NativeGic 8/10 actual PASS; its 21 inherited project modules plus its fresh object give the exact 22-project closure. Three direct external boundaries, the inherited HFS.Seq boundary, Init and Omega remain separately pinned. Historical upstream QuantifierCore limitations remain explicit; this unit does not claim to rebuild or attest the whole dependency cache.

The guard is a successor of the actual NativeGic check-v2.py. Its parent segment validates the modern NativeGic record, exact raw source/audit commands, logs and probes, all current parent inputs, first providers, and the pre-audit fresh-object capture. The source/audit execution and postcheck tail are identical to that executed guard except for the new 11-caller count: shared 120-second budget, -j1, -M4096, no proof-limit override, compiler-version query, dependency build or download. The output must be fresh and external to both repositories. No guard, proof compiler, simulator or supplied program has been invoked by the author.

# Fixed-label native GIC matrix congruence

The [checked source](Lean/ZFCinPA/ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.lean) proves matrix congruence for the literal validator GIC circuit in every internal model of IΣ₁. If `CProv` proves both implications between arbitrary matrix values `p` and `q`, it proves both implications between `internalGic a b c p` and `internalGic a b c q`. The three labels stay fixed; this finite congruence theorem needs no freshness premise.

Applying the result to double-negation padding removes padding from the matrix while keeping the existential witness label `pad p`. The [literal introduction theorem](validator_native_gic254.md) then gives

```text
CProv (wal 3 (internalGic 1 3 (pad p) p))
```

for every internal `p`, including zero. The audit also checks coincident-label congruence. The witness label is not changed to `p`. Identifying the configurable Foundation body with this literal circuit, alpha transport, arbitrary universal closure and internal derivation translation remain separate R2 obligations. This unit supplies no full native-theory translation or PA consistency endpoint.

The [actual record](results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-verification.json) passed eight probes and eleven typed callers with zero warnings. Source elaboration took 2.51841 seconds and the audit 2.13346 seconds under one shared 120-second budget, `-j1 -M4096` and default proof limits. All eight reports use only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The guard recorded the fresh source object and its first-provider identity before the audit, then rechecked every selected input and fresh object. No compiler-version query, download or dependency build was performed.

This is the unit's first recorded actual attempt. Its source, audit and executed guard are unchanged. The [history](results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-history.json) preserves the source-only readiness statement, preparation, actual logs, source snapshots and reviews. Earlier failure and repair evidence belongs to the already published [parent introduction history](results/validator-native-gic254-history.json), not to an invented failed congruence run.

The exact boundary has 22 project source/object pairs, three direct external pairs plus the inherited `Foundation.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.HFS.Seq` pair, and Init/Omega. The run records 84 inputs and 28 first providers. The immediate NativeGic parent has a modern shared budget and pre-audit capture. The older [QuantifierCore evidence](validator_quantifier_core254.md) retains its per-command 120-second limits, recorded compiler-version query and absence of the modern first-provider capture. Supplied dependency objects are selected and hashed; the whole cache is not independently attested or rebuilt.
